note: The Snackbar set itself is hidden in the kit; the visible "Examples" instances (with their text overrides) are the references.

snackbar-long-2-close.allowedDiffReason: Kit slip: the examples' action buttons keep the building block's fixed 59px width, so "Action" (42px) starts at the 12px padding instead of being hugged, and "Longer Action" (89px) is clipped by the frame. Our action hugs its label (M3); the label and everything right of the text shift accordingly.
